items.title: 68113_Barney Bigard oral history interview
items.q: The interviewee confirms the identity of 'Peggy Lee' as the singer who 'used to be with Benny Goodman' and was brought back by 'he' (presumably Benny Goodman), but does not describe a direct personal or professional relationship with Peggy Lee herself.

ctx.x: Oh, he brought her back from where and when?
